# Debt Bondage Case Study of a Migrant Worker in Malaysia: Aslam

[Visit microsite![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](/initiative/ffact/)

Select language:

[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)EN](#)[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)BN](#)

Date

2024

Share

[![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) opens an external website in a new tab](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https://verite.org/resource/debt-bondage-case-study-of-a-migrant-worker-in-malaysia-aslam/) [![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) opens an external website in a new tab](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://verite.org/resource/debt-bondage-case-study-of-a-migrant-worker-in-malaysia-aslam/) [![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) opens an external website in a new tab](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https://verite.org/resource/debt-bondage-case-study-of-a-migrant-worker-in-malaysia-aslam/) [![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,) opens an external website in a new tab](mailto:?body=https://verite.org/resource/debt-bondage-case-study-of-a-migrant-worker-in-malaysia-aslam/)

This video describes what debt bondage is and provides a case study of a worker from Bangladesh who finds himself in a situation of debt bondage.

The video was created by the [FFACT Project](/initiative/ffact/), which combats debt bondage among migrant workers by making recruitment costs transparent, empowering worker groups with data, and promoting accountability among employers, recruiters, and governments in key migration corridors.

Filed under:

Malaysia, Bangladesh
